title: Dungeon Totems
summary: Totems of Undying that still save your life, but leave a curse behind: lost hearts, a zombie body, a rampage, a melon diet and more. Evokers drop them.

screenshots.title: The totems
screenshots.description: Weakness, Fatigue, Heartbreak, Blindness, Morphing, Zombification, Rage and Void.

screenshots.title: It still saves you
screenshots.description: A Heartbreak Totem pops just like the vanilla totem.

screenshots.title: Then the curse
screenshots.description: Heartbreak takes 2 of your hearts for 20 minutes.

screenshots.title: Morphing
screenshots.description: Turn into a random animal for 20 seconds, with its size, speed and health.

screenshots.title: A different animal each time
screenshots.description: Monsters leave you alone until you change back.

screenshots.title: Even an iron golem
screenshots.description: Fourteen animals are in the pool, from chickens to iron golems.

screenshots.title: Zombified
screenshots.description: Zombies treat you as one of them. Cure yourself within 10 minutes.

screenshots.title: Evokers
screenshots.description: The only place to find them.

screenshots.title: A random totem
screenshots.description: Each evoker drops a random one in place of the vanilla totem.
